name: Kamori
description: Kamori was a world in the Core Worlds. Its most accomplished artists were sometimes awarded the title of "living treasure", which was granted to the Glanthe painter Dana Dregond around 10 BBY. In 0 ABY, the Zethusian plains on Kamori were struck by a series of powerful groundquakes. They resulted in the deaths of several hundred thousand people and extensive damage to three cities in the area.
